title: How do i set an absolute rating count?

posts.name: Haseeb Ahmed
posts.cooked:
I created a custom rating type field called “Rating” and I want the user to be able to only choose an absolute count value when the user is rating.

For Example, a user can only choose stars 1, 2, and 3 and cannot choose partial ratings (decimal values) such as 0.15, 0.35, 0.50, etc.

I cannot find how to do that, is there any property of the rating type field to be set?

Reference screenshot for better understanding:

image982×449 25.1 KB

posts.name: Ejaaz Khan
posts.cooked:
You can add validation in client-side scripts or server-side scripts in the validate method to restrict selecting partial ratings.

python code

def validate(self):
		if((self.rating * 10)  % 2) != 0:
			frappe.throw("Your Error message")

Javascript code

frappe.ui.form.on("Doctype", {
    validate:function(frm){
        if((frm.doc.rating * 10) % 2){
            frappe.throw("Your Error message")
        }
    }
})

UPDATED:
JS code considering rating field set to three star:

frappe.ui.form.on("Doctype", {
    validate:function(frm){
        const targets = [0.333, 0.666, 0.999];
        let ratingValue = frm.rating;
        let gotAbsCount = targets.reduce((a, b) => 
            Math.abs(ratingValue - a) < Math.abs(ratingValue - b) ? a : b
        );
        alert(gotAbsCount);
    }
})

posts.name: Eugene Parsons
posts.cooked:
You can also make a ‘.left-half.star-click’ behave as if a ‘.right-half.star-click’ was clicked.

Add the following to the refresh event of the parent in case the Rating docfield is on a child grid, as is the case in the below code.

refresh: function(frm) {
	setTimeout(() => {
		const $votes_grid = $(frm.fields_dict.votes.grid.wrapper);
		console.log('Votes grid wrapper:', $votes_grid);
		// Make left-half clicks trigger full-star behavior
		$votes_grid.on('click', '.left-half.star-click', function(e) {
			console.log('L clicked', e.target);
			e.stopPropagation();
			const $star = $(this).closest('svg');
			const rating = parseInt($star.attr('data-rating'));
			console.log("Star rating:", rating);
			// Simulate right-half click
			$star.find('.right-half').trigger('click');
			console.log("R triggered");
			// Force whole number (optional backup)
			// frm.set_value('vote', rating);
		});
	}, 500);
}

Also note that the Rating docfield can take an Int Option, being the number of stars. However, there is no setting to change the half star increments, hence the above code.
